entities.summary: Konda-Dhora, also known simply as Konda or Kubi, is a Dravidian language spoken in India. It is spoken by the Konda-Dora scheduled tribe, who mostly live in the Parvathipiram Manyam district of Andhra Pradesh, and the Koraput district of Odisha. Konda is a modern language with roots in Asia.
